data.name: Dream Abstract
data.detailed_description:
Survive the Curse

For centuries, the Curse has chosen its victims without reason or mercy. Young or old, innocent or guilty—none who have faced the Curse Guardians have ever returned.

Now, it has chosen you.

Trapped within its dream, you must forge a build powerful enough to defeat the Curse Guardians and survive what no one else has.

Start where other ARPGs end

Dream Abstract removes the campaign standing between you and the systems that define your character.

Every skill, item, crafting system, and path to power is open from the start. Experiment immediately, pursue the mechanics that interest you, and shape your character around the build you want to create.

There is no prescribed route through the game. How you grow—and when you are ready to face the final encounter—is up to you.

Build for the Guardians

The Curse Guardians are the ultimate test of everything you have created.

Each month, a new combination of three Guardians takes control of the final encounter. Every Guardian brings distinct mechanics, offensive strengths, and defensive advantages—making some builds naturally better suited to the challenge than others.

Study the lineup. Identify its weaknesses. Forge the best build to defeat the Guardians.

Compete on execution

Dream Abstract features an asynchronous leaderboard built around active combat time.

The clock advances while you are fighting, not while you are studying systems, comparing items, or planning your next move. Take the time you need to understand your build—then prove its strength through efficient progression, mechanical execution, and mastery of the final encounter.

FEATURES

  • Endgame-first ARPG progression with no campaign barrier

  • Every system and path to power available from the start

  • Build-defining items and deeply interconnected mechanics

  • Enemies designed around distinct combat challenges

  • A new combination of Curse Guardians to overcome each month

  • Asynchronous competition measured through active combat time

Single-player with persistent online progression

Dream Abstract is played solo, but requires Steam and a persistent internet connection. Your Dreams, progression and items are saved to your Dream Abstract account, while online services support competitive progression and asynchronous global, friends and community leaderboards. No separate account creation is required. There is no offline mode, co-op or PvP.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4 GB / AMD Radeon RX 570 4 GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan-compatible GPU and current drivers required. Intended for 1920×1080 at 30 FPS.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super 6 GB / RTX 2060 6 GB / AMD RX 5600 XT 6 GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible audio device
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan-compatible GPU and current drivers required. SSD recommended. Intended for 1920×1080 at 60 FPS.
